1	# Plan: #187, a plan review rerun keeps the owner's revision
2	
3	References are to this worktree. "Facts" is `facts.md` for #187; "Settled" lines are cited by their claim.
4	
5	## Where this departs from the issue
6	
7	- The issue says the `revise` note "should survive a runner failure the same way an answered decision does". It already does: `revise()` writes it to `review/<n>/joined/plan.feedback-<round>.md` before sending and deletes it only if Switchboard refuses (`dispatch/src/scheduler.rs:7616-7642`; Facts, Settled: the note survives on disk). The plan adds no copy of the note to the record.
8	- The issue frames the loss as a rerun-after-failure bug. The same `review_subject` rule (`scheduler.rs:10534-10548`, called at `:7465`) loses the revision on park then resume, where a cancelled review attempt is rerun through `rerun_ask`'s `Cancelled` arm (`:9363-9368`; Facts, Settled). The fix sits in the shared path, so it covers both.
9	- The investigation says the record is "schema version 19". That is when `revisions` was added (`docs/dispatch.md:393`). The version today is `RECORD_VERSION = 28` (`dispatch/src/store.rs:26`). `SCHEMA_VERSION = 16` at `store.rs:12` is the Switchboard app store's and is not touched.
10	- The issue's "at least say in the rerun question and in `show` which copy it will review" is done in full. The question text and `show` both name the copy.
11	
12	## The record
13	
14	One additive field on `Attempt` (`dispatch/src/ticket.rs`, beside `revisions` at `:350`): `seeded_from: Option<u32>`, `#[serde(default)]`. It is the number of the earlier attempt of the same stage and context whose copy this attempt's reviewed copy was copied from. `None` means copied from the newest complete attempt, as today.
15	
16	Why a field and not a derivation from the `rerun` decision: a later reader (`show`, a third attempt) needs to know what the copy holds, and a rerun answer can be withdrawn or re-asked. The record should say what was reviewed.
17	
18	Bump `RECORD_VERSION` to the value in `store.rs` at implementation time, plus one. Add the `migrate` step, which transforms nothing (the neighbouring 18-to-19 step is the pattern, `store.rs:~555`). The comment says a build that would drop the field on its next write must refuse the record, or a third attempt would restart from the original. Add the version line to `docs/dispatch.md` after the existing version list (`:385-400`).
19	
20	One helper, `Attempt::holds_revision()`: `!revisions.is_empty() || seeded_from.is_some()`.
21	- It is not proof the reviser finished. Facts, Settled: a non-empty `revisions` means the revise was sent or its fate unknown (`NO_ANSWER` keeps it, `scheduler.rs:11285-11313`).
22	- `seeded_from` is set only when a revision was carried, so a chain of failures (review/2 fails, then review/3) keeps carrying.
23	- Facts, For the owner: the plan must not rely on `revisions` alone. It does not. The helper only decides whether to offer a choice and to default to the carried copy. The owner's answer decides, and the question shows the path.
24	- Because `revisions` is not proof, no text calls the copy "revised" on `holds_revision()` alone. The question says "the copy a revise was sent to". The word `owner_revised` on `show` (the UI section) is true only when the feedback file for a `revisions` round exists beside the copy (`report::round_file`, written at `scheduler.rs:7616` before the send; Facts, Settled: the file's existence is the evidence the run opened the round), or when `seeded_from` is set.
25	
26	## The signals
27	
28	None new. Runner failure (`review run gone`, `scheduler.rs:7757-7763`) stays terminal for the attempt, and the plan does not try to re-attach the run (Facts, Unresolved: why the app answers `no such run`).
29	
30	## The actions and effects
31	
32	No new `Effect`, `Body` or port method. Changes are in `dispatch/src/scheduler.rs`, plus one answer in `pipeline.rs`, one seed line in `supervisor.rs` and `Decision::acted_rerun` in `ticket.rs`.
33	
34	1. **Rerun options.** A new `fn rerun_options` returns `["rerun", "original", "park"]` for a failed or cancelled `Workflow` attempt where `holds_revision()` is true and its copy exists on disk, else the current set.
35	   - `rerun_ask` (`:9335-9379`) calls it for both its `Failed` and `Cancelled` arms. This covers park then resume.
36	   - `fail_attempt` (`:7157`) passes it instead of the fixed `["rerun", "park"]`.
37	   - The option sets stay literal `&'static [&'static str]` slices, as `rerun_ask` returns today. `rewrite_choices(a, options)` is unchanged: a plan review never fails at checks or rewrite.
38	   - `rerun` is the default and carries that copy forward. `original` is today's behaviour. This is the design that works whichever way the owner's answer on "is the revised plan the one I approved" goes (Facts, For the owner): `original` is always one answer away.
39	2. **Question text.** `rerun_carries` (`:9382-9392`) gets a `Workflow` arm for the `holds_revision()` case: `` `rerun` reviews <path of the failed attempt's plan.md>, the copy a revise was sent to, and `original` reviews <plan stage's path> again. If the review died while the planner was editing, the copy may be incomplete. ``
40	   - The arm builds a `String`, so `rerun_carries` returns `String` instead of `&'static str`; a `&'static str` cannot hold a path computed at run time, which is why the return type changes. Its callers format it into the question already.
41	   - The wording follows Facts, Settled (`scheduler.rs:11285-11313`): non-empty `revisions` means the revise was sent or its fate unknown, not that the planner finished it. When `seeded_from` is set and `revisions` is empty, the arm says "the copy this attempt started from".
42	   - This is the visibility Facts, Unresolved (mid-edit kill) asks for. Nothing is copied silently, and the plan makes no claim about completeness either way.
43	   - `ask_rerun` and `fail_attempt` both build their text through this function, so the first question and a re-ask after a park read the same.
44	3. **Answer handling.**
45	   - `Decision::acted_rerun` (`ticket.rs:930`) accepts the answer `original` as well as `rerun`, so `may_rerun` (`scheduler.rs:10665`) launches on either.
46	   - The two matches on `("rerun", "rerun")` (`:3468`, `:3524`) become `("rerun", "rerun" | "original")`. Only the first has a note; `original` carries none.
47	   - `ANSWERS` (`pipeline.rs:111`) gets `("original", "`rerun`")`, as `keep` and `check` have. `decides` takes decision names, not answers: the loops at `pipeline.rs:2165` and `:2171` accept `rerun` and reject `original` with "is an answer to `rerun`; name the decision". A supervisor allowed `rerun` may answer any option the question lists, `original` included, so those checks need no change.
48	   - `decision_words("rerun")` (`dispatch/src/supervisor.rs:69-73`) is the seed text a supervisor reads, and lists only `rerun`, `check` and `keep`. It gains: "`original` reviews the plan stage's copy again, when the question offers it". Without it a supervisor never learns the owner may want the original. The existing assertion at `supervisor.rs:1274` checks only the line's opening and still holds.
49	   - The authorised-unlaunched check at `:10674` goes through `acted_rerun` and needs no change.
50	4. **`start_workflow`** (`:7436`). Before the copy at `:7458-7471`:
51	   - Let `prev = latest_attempt(t, &stage.name, ctx)`. If it is a failed or cancelled `Workflow` attempt, `holds_revision()` is true, its answer for this attempt is not `original`, its `plan.md` exists, **and the plan it was copied from is still current**, use that file as `source_path` and set `seeded_from = Some(prev.n)` on the new attempt after the push at `:7476`.
52	   - The currency check, `subject_unchanged_since(t, &subject, prev)`: no `Complete` attempt that wrote `subject` sits after `prev` in `t.attempts`. The vector is chronological (`review_subject` walks it in reverse on that assumption), so a plan redone after review/1 started, by a send-back or a restart, puts a newer `Complete` plan attempt after it. `review_subject` would pick that attempt, and the check fails.
53	   - When the check fails, copy from `review_subject` as today (`seeded_from` stays `None`) and log a warning naming the newer plan attempt. The owner's `rerun` answer is honoured as a rerun; only the carry is withheld.
54	   - `rerun_options` runs the same check, so a plan redone before the question is asked offers no `original`: nothing is carried, so there is nothing to choose. `start_workflow` must check again because a plan can be redone after the question is asked.
55	   - `source_session` still comes from `review_subject`, unchanged. The app clones the session that wrote `plan/1`, and it cannot see the owner's note (Facts, Settled: only the file carries the revision). The carried file holds the revised text, so nothing is handed to the clone. If a reviewer turns out to need the note, that is the follow-up below, because `WorkflowStart` has no field for it and this commit adds none.
56	   - If the carried file is missing, log a warning and fall back to the original. The question only offers the choice when the file existed at ask time, so this is a race, not a path.
57	5. **Readers left alone.** `review_subject` (the session and the first copy), `input_where` (`ticket.rs:1452`), `shown_where` (`:1476`) and the lane readers keep their `Complete`-only rule. A failed review's copy must never feed a later stage's prompt, and the Plan tab contract is that agents are handed complete files only (`docs/design.md:~2158`, quoted in the investigation). `report.rs` `plan_review` (`:355-380`) counts rounds per attempt from each copy's feedback files, so it is unaffected. The new attempt starts at round 1 with no feedback files, and the owner's round stays with review/1.
58	
59	## The UI
60	
61	`show` and its wire types only. `dispatch-control` additions (additive, struct-level `#[serde(default)]`, `lib.rs:584`):
62	- `LaneFile.seeded_from: Option<u32>`.
63	- `PathsView.plan_earlier: Vec<EarlierCopy>` with `EarlierCopy { stage, n, path, state, owner_revised }`, where `owner_revised` is the on-disk test from the record section (a feedback file exists for a `revisions` round), not `holds_revision()`.
64	
65	`ticket_paths` (`serve.rs:~539`) fills them. `plan_earlier` lists failed or cancelled workflow attempts that `holds_revision()` and are not the shown copy. `print_lane_files` (`main.rs:896-907`) gets:
66	
67	```
68	  plan: .../review/2/joined/plan.md
69	    (reviewed copy, review open; started from review/1's copy)
70	  plan, earlier: .../review/1/joined/plan.md (review/1 failed, revise note on disk)
71	```
72	
73	When `seeded_from` is `None` and a plan review is open, the line says `started from stage plan`. Between the failure and the answer, `show` still names `plan/1` as the shown plan, because `shown_where` is unchanged. The `plan, earlier` line and the question are what flag the revision there.
74	
75	The Dispatch page's plan label (`src/ui/ticket.rs:~425`) reads the same `PathsView`, so it receives the fields. New wording there is out of this commit.
76	
77	## The tests
78	
79	Dispatch scheduler tests, beside the existing review tests near `scheduler.rs:12836`, with the fake app and `Clock::at`:
80	- Revised review/1 fails, `rerun` is answered: the review/2 copy has review/1's bytes, `seeded_from == Some(1)`, and `WorkflowStart.plan` is the review/2 path with plan/1's session as `source`.
81	- Same, answered `original`: the copy has plan/1's bytes and `seeded_from == None`.
82	- Plan redone between the failure and the answer: review/1 fails with a revision, a newer `Complete` plan/2 is pushed, `rerun` is answered. The review/2 copy has plan/2's bytes, `seeded_from == None`, and `WorkflowStart.plan` is the review/2 path. Also, a plan redone before the question is asked offers `["rerun", "park"]`.
83	- A `revisions` entry whose feedback file is absent (`NO_ANSWER`): the question offers `original` but does not call the copy revised, and `show` omits the revise-note tag; with the file present it shows it.
84	- Supervisor seed: the `rerun` line of `decision_words` mentions `original`; a pipeline file whose `decides` lists `original` is refused with the `ANSWERS` message (tests near `pipeline.rs:2483`).
85	- Review/1 failed unrevised: today's behaviour, options `["rerun", "park"]`.
86	- Chain: review/2 (seeded) fails, `rerun` gives review/3 the review/2 copy; `original` on review/2 then makes review/3 unseeded.
87	- Park then resume of a revised open review: the cancelled attempt's question offers `original` and the rerun carries the copy.
88	- The question text names both paths and the incompleteness caveat. A missing carried file falls back to the original.
89	- `Decision::acted_rerun` is true for `original` (`ticket.rs` tests near `:1819`).
90	- Store: a record at the previous version loads with `seeded_from == None`, migrates to the new `RECORD_VERSION` (pattern at `store.rs:971`), and a newer one is refused.
